summary: Game Decryption feature testing complete. All 11 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI fully functional with Coach/Decrypt toggle, move-by-move coaching cards, navigation controls, and feedback submission.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Game Decryption feature fully verified. Key endpoints: GET /api/coach/decryption/{gameId} returns move-by-move coaching with decryption_data array and summary. POST /api/coach/decryption/feedback submits user corrections. On-demand generation works for games analyzed before the feature was added. Frontend at /game/{gameId} has Coach/Decrypt toggle buttons. Decrypt view shows Game Overview with stats (total moves, good moves, mistakes), move coaching cards with what_happened, move_idea, your_focus, opponent_last_idea, mistake details, and praise. Navigation works with arrow buttons and keyboard (← → ↑ ↓). Not Helpful button opens feedback panel with textarea.
